name: Save & Continue for Elementor Forms
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
This plugin extends the power of Elementor Forms by providing advanced submission management, PDF generation, and secure draft saving. Instead of just sending form data through email, it allows you to store, access, and re-use submissions in a more professional way.

DEMO:
Download Pro Version: https://add-ons.org/plugin/save-continue-for-elementor-forms-pro/
Documents: https://add-ons.org/document-save-continue-for-elementor-forms/

Features

  • Save draft form entries with a unique token.
  • Resume form completion anytime without data loss.
  • Secure saving using WordPress Ajax & nonce validation.
  • Fully compatible with Elementor Pro Forms.
  • Automatic Data Cleanup: A daily cron job automatically deletes old records after 30 days to keep your database clean and optimized.
  • Email Integration: Send submission data directly to your inbox.

Use Cases

  • Long multi-step registration forms.
  • Job application forms.
  • Surveys or questionnaires requiring more time to complete.
sections.installation:
Normal installation

  1. Download the xxxx.zip file to your computer.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Upload the xxxx directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
